verdict.rationale: Oracle's own docs describe an OCI Terraform provider that connects Terraform to the OCI services you manage, which implies a vendor-maintained provider. They also describe Resource Manager importing existing Terraform state, showing first-party integration. Beyond that, the evidence only establishes that the provider exists; it does not show the release cadence, how much of the core services it covers, or OpenTofu compatibility. missing for 10: evidence of active release cadence/versioning, documented service coverage breadth, OpenTofu support, independent or hands-on corroboration of provider quality
